The Tang Hua Kung Fu X Mala Chuan Chuan pop-up that received explosive responses at The Hyundai Seoul has returned to Pangyo Hyundai Department Store. You can experience ‘Mala Chuan Chuan,’ a Chinese Sichuan skewer dish, reinterpreted in Tang Hua Kung Fu’s own style. Choose your skewers according to your taste and choose from five flavors! From Mala Tang skewers with a rich broth that’s perfect for Korean palates to tomato Tang skewers, a favorite of Mala enthusiasts! Add guo bao rou for a perfect combination. Come experience the new and convenient Mala Chuan Chuan at The Hyundai Pangyo. ⠀
